family_name: Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Static

spec.description:
Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Static are elegant suspended acoustic
screens crafted from 12mm Cube panels with precision water-cut geometric
patterns. Designed to hang effortlessly from the ceiling to the floor, they
establish visual privacy and spatial zones without blocking sightlines or light.
Engineered to absorb reverberated sound and reduce ambient chatter, they provide
an acoustic and aesthetic feature for open-plan commercial and educational
interiors.
features:
Precision water-cut open pattern designs for
line-of-sight and light flow

Crafted from 12mm solid colour Cube polyester
panel

Suspended from ceilings via Frontier aluminium channel and adjustable
cables
Reduces reverberation and background chatter in open spaces
Available in standard 1200mm x 2400mm screen size

Choice of more than 20
solid colours and custom water-cut patterns

Group 1 fire rating to AS
ISO 9705 - 2003

Manufactured with minimum 80% recycled post-consumer PET
fibre
Carbon neutral certified product with third-party verified EPD

technical.value:
Frontier extruded aluminium channel
with 1m suspension cables

range.variant: Cascade Static Screen (Pattern S1-S14 or Custom)

spec.fire:
AS ISO 9705 - 2003: Group 1; ISO 9705: Group 1-S; BS
EN 13501-1:2018: B - s2, d0
spec.compliance:
NCC BCA Group 1 fire compliance; AS
ISO 9705:2003; ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 accredited manufacturing
spec.sustainability:
Minimum 80% recycled PET; certified Carbon Neutral; Declare
Red List Free; 100% recyclable
install:
Establish ceiling suspension
points aligned with channel attachment sliders

Fasten ceiling connectors
securely to structural ceiling or soffit

Attach Frontier channel along the
top edge of the 12mm static screen

Connect suspension wires to ceiling
connectors and adjust screen height
Ensure screen hangs plumb and level

If
installing base channel, anchor base cable connectors to floor and attach to
lower channel

Push black end caps into channel ends for a clean finished
look
selection_checklist:
Select static pattern design from lookbook or
request custom water-cut profile

Choose screen colour from Autex Cube
palette

Confirm ceiling height and check if 1m suspension wires are
sufficient

Decide between free-hanging (top only) or floor-anchored (top &
bottom) installation
accessories:
Cascade suspension kit (Frontier channel, ceiling
connectors, 1m wires, sliders)
limitations:
Not a physical impact barrier or security
partition

Free-hanging screens may sway if placed in strong air currents or
doorway drafts
Avoid sharp bending of panel during installation

problem_keywords:
glare and chatter in commercial
spaces
use_cases:
suspending
between workstation clusters in tech offices to dampen speech chatter

creating semi-private consultation zones in bank branches and customer service
centres

defining circulation paths in open-plan corporate and educational
facilities

introducing decorative suspended acoustic art into high-ceilinged
hospitality venues
not_for:
complete acoustic isolation requiring
airtight partitions
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens
- Static are ceiling-suspended 12mm acoustic panels precision water-cut with
intricate geometric patterns. Formed from solid-colour Cube polyester felt,
these static screens soften sound reverberation and background speech while
maintaining sightlines and open airflow across commercial interiors. Supplied
with Frontier aluminium channels and height-adjustable suspension cables, they
provide a Group 1 fire-rated, carbon-neutral solution for zoning open spaces.
